leads.claim: The Roswell Army Air Field reported the recovery of a flying disc, which was subsequently identified by the military as a radar-tracking balloon.
leads.why: The document explicitly identifies the recovered material as a conventional radar-tracking balloon associated with a classified project, not UAP material.

leads.claim: An Eighth Air Force official informed the FBI that a hexagonal-shaped disc suspended from a balloon was recovered and sent to Wright Field for examination.
leads.why: The document clarifies that the recovered object was a high-altitude weather balloon with a radar reflector, which is conventional debris.

doc_verdict: This document contains no evidence of UAP-related material, as it consistently identifies the Roswell wreckage as debris from a classified high-altitude balloon project (Project MOGUL).
